goal:
Define the vision for: Analyze the Foreman project and create an absolutely spectacular, show-stopping README.md in English. Foreman is an autonomous AI coding agent and task orchestrator featuring a powerful 4-layer Forge pipeline (Visioner, Strategist, Researcher, Worker), direct tool use, sub-agent spawning, and persistent memory.

REQUIREMENTS FOR THE README:
1. ASCII ART: Must include stunning, high-quality ASCII art of a blacksmith striking an anvil (representing the "Forge") at the top. Use other ASCII decorations (gears, hammers, borders) throughout the document to make it visually striking.
2. DUAL AUDIENCE: 
   - Non-Technical: Explain what Foreman does using clear metaphors (e.g., a master builder orchestrating a highly efficient factory, taking high-level visions and turning them into reality).
   - Technical: Provide deep, realistic technical details (architecture, the 4-layer pipeline, execution engine, sub-agent orchestration, Git checkpointing, memory persistence, sandbox security).
3. TONE: Epic, highly professional, awe-inspiring, and a bit of a "show-off". It should read like the documentation for a cutting-edge piece of industrial software.
4. ACTION: Write the final masterpiece to `README.md` in the project root (overwrite if it exists). Make sure it is perfectly formatted Markdown.

Go all out. Make this the best README this project has ever seen.
